fcdo.title: UK Government foreign travel advice (Open Government Licence v3.0)

entry.en: To enter Liberia, your passport must be valid for the duration of your stay.
entry.es: Para entrar en Liberia, tu pasaporte debe ser válido durante toda tu estancia.
entry.quote: To enter Liberia, your passport must be valid for the duration of your stay.

entry.en: As part of the visa application you need a certificate proving a yellow fever vaccination.
entry.es: Como parte de la solicitud de visado necesitas un certificado que acredite la vacuna contra la fiebre amarilla.
entry.quote: As part of the visa application process, you need to provide a certificate to prove you’ve had a yellow fever vaccination.

entry.en: Liberia announced heightened health screening for arriving travellers due to Ebola outbreaks in Uganda and the Democratic Republic of Congo.
entry.es: Liberia anunció controles sanitarios reforzados para los viajeros que llegan, por brotes de ébola en Uganda y la República Democrática del Congo.
entry.quote: announcing heighted health screening measures for travellers arriving into Liberia, due to outbreaks of Ebola in Uganda and the Democratic Republic of Congo

entry.en: You must declare cash or travellers cheques worth 10,000 US dollars or more.
entry.es: Debes declarar efectivo o cheques de viaje por valor de 10.000 dólares estadounidenses o más.
entry.quote: Declare cash or travellers cheques if the value is 10,000 US dollars or more.

entry.en: You cannot take more than 7,500 US dollars in cash out of the country.
entry.es: No puedes sacar del país más de 7.500 dólares estadounidenses en efectivo.
entry.quote: You cannot take more than 7,500 US dollars in cash out of the country.

entry.en: Carry photo ID at all times, such as a driving licence or a copy of your passport photo page.
entry.es: Lleva siempre un documento con foto, como el carné de conducir o una copia de la página de la foto del pasaporte.
entry.quote: Carry photo ID with you at all times, such as your driving licence or a copy of the photo page of your passport.

safety.en: The crime rate in Liberia is high; Liberians are the main victims, but foreign nationals can also be targeted.
safety.es: La tasa de criminalidad en Liberia es alta; los liberianos son las principales víctimas, pero los extranjeros también pueden ser objetivo.
safety.quote: The crime rate in Liberia is high. Liberians are the main victims of crime, but foreign nationals can also be targeted.

safety.en: Foreign nationals have been mugged in the Mamba Point and Sinkor areas of Monrovia, where most international visitors stay.
safety.es: Se ha atracado a extranjeros en las zonas de Mamba Point y Sinkor de Monrovia, donde se alojan la mayoría de visitantes internacionales.
safety.quote: Foreign nationals have been mugged in the Mamba Point and Sinkor areas of Monrovia, where most international visitors stay.

safety.en: Liberia has a high rate of rape and sexual assault.
safety.es: Liberia tiene una alta tasa de violaciones y agresiones sexuales.
safety.quote: Liberia has a high rate of rape and sexual assault.

safety.en: Same-sex sexual activity is illegal in Liberia.
safety.es: Las relaciones sexuales entre personas del mismo sexo son ilegales en Liberia.
safety.quote: Same-sex sexual activity is illegal in Liberia.

safety.en: Road conditions deteriorate significantly in the rainy season from May to November, and many roads become impassable.
safety.es: Las condiciones de las carreteras empeoran mucho en la temporada de lluvias, de mayo a noviembre, y muchas se vuelven impracticables.
safety.quote: Driving and road conditions deteriorate significantly during the rainy season from May to November, and many roads become impassable.

safety.en: There are occasional clashes between armed groups on both sides of the Côte d'Ivoire border in remote parts of Grand Gedeh and River Gee counties.
safety.es: Hay enfrentamientos ocasionales entre grupos armados a ambos lados de la frontera con Costa de Marfil en zonas remotas de los condados de Grand Gedeh y River Gee.
safety.quote: There are occasional clashes between armed groups from both sides of the Liberia-Côte d’Ivoire border in some of the more remote border areas of Grand Gedeh and River Gee counties.

health.en: Typhoid, malaria and worms are very common.
health.es: La fiebre tifoidea, la malaria y los parásitos intestinales son muy comunes.
health.quote: Typhoid, malaria, and worms are very common.

health.en: There is a risk of Lassa fever in Liberia, with several confirmed cases in 2026.
health.es: Existe riesgo de fiebre de Lassa en Liberia, con varios casos confirmados en 2026.
health.quote: There is also a risk of Lassa fever in Liberia, with several confirmed cases in 2026.

health.en: Hospitals and medical facilities are poorly equipped, blood supplies are unreliable and unsafe, and quality medication is scarce.
health.es: Los hospitales y centros médicos están mal equipados, el suministro de sangre no es fiable ni seguro y escasean los medicamentos de calidad.
health.quote: Hospitals and medical facilities throughout Liberia are poorly equipped. Blood supplies are unreliable and unsafe, and quality medication is scarce.

health.en: Make sure you have adequate travel health insurance and accessible funds for medical treatment, evacuation and repatriation.
health.es: Asegúrate de tener un seguro médico de viaje adecuado y fondos accesibles para tratamiento médico, evacuación y repatriación.
health.quote: Make sure you have adequate travel health insurance and accessible funds to cover the cost of any medical treatment abroad, medical evacuation and repatriation.

health.en: Bagged water is supposed to be filtered and safe but is not guaranteed to be, so stick with bottled water.
health.es: El agua en bolsa debería estar filtrada y ser segura, pero no está garantizado, así que usa agua embotellada.
health.quote: While it is supposed to be filtered and safe, it is not guaranteed to be. Stick with bottled water to be sure.

health.en: Make sure you have adequate supplies of prescription medication, bearing in mind the risk of delays from flight cancellations.
health.es: Asegúrate de llevar suficientes medicamentos recetados, teniendo en cuenta el riesgo de retrasos por cancelaciones de vuelos.
health.quote: Make sure you have adequate supplies of prescription medication, bearing in mind the risk of delays due to flight cancellations.

help.en: The police number is +231 770 800 911, and emergency services are unreliable in Liberia.
help.es: El número de la policía es +231 770 800 911 y los servicios de emergencia no son fiables en Liberia.
help.quote: Police: +231 770 800 911 Emergency services are unreliable in Liberia.

help.en: There is no reliable ambulance service, so for emergency treatment you should make your own way to hospital.
help.es: No hay un servicio de ambulancias fiable, así que ante una urgencia médica debes ir por tus propios medios al hospital.
help.quote: There is no reliable ambulance service in Liberia. If you need emergency medical treatment, you should make your own way to hospital.

help.en: It is advisable to inform your embassy that you are in the country in case of evacuation.
help.es: Es aconsejable informar a tu embajada de que estás en el país por si hay una evacuación.
help.quote: It is advisable to inform your embassy that you are in the country in case of evacuation.

getting_in.en: The only international airport is Roberts International Airport, about 60 km from central Monrovia.
getting_in.es: El único aeropuerto internacional es el Roberts International, a unos 60 km del centro de Monrovia.
getting_in.quote: The country's only international airport is Roberts International Airport (ROB IATA) (often called Roberts International Airport or RIA), some 60 km from the city center of Monrovia at Robertsfield.

getting_in.en: Ethiopia Airlines has flights from Addis Ababa.
getting_in.es: Ethiopia Airlines tiene vuelos desde Adís Abeba.
getting_in.quote: Ethiopia Airlines has flights from Addis Ababa.

getting_in.en: KLM flies from Amsterdam and Freetown.
getting_in.es: KLM vuela desde Ámsterdam y Freetown.

getting_in.en: Roads from Monrovia to Buchanan and to the borders with Sierra Leone at Bo Waterside and Guinea at Ganta are mainly paved and in reasonable condition.
getting_in.es: Las carreteras de Monrovia a Buchanan y a las fronteras con Sierra Leona en Bo Waterside y con Guinea en Ganta están mayormente asfaltadas y en estado razonable.
getting_in.quote: The roads from Monrovia to the port town of Buchanan and to the border with Sierra Leone at Bo Waterside, and to the border with Guinea at Ganta, are mainly paved and in reasonable condition.

getting_around.en: There is no real train service in Liberia.
getting_around.es: No hay un servicio ferroviario real en Liberia.
getting_around.quote: There is no real train service.

getting_around.en: Most Monrovia street taxis pick up several passengers en route and are often jam-packed.
getting_around.es: La mayoría de los taxis de calle de Monrovia recogen a varios pasajeros por el camino y suelen ir abarrotados.
getting_around.quote: Most Monrovia taxis on the streets will pick up several passengers en route, and are therefore often jam-packed.

getting_around.en: Long distance shared taxis leave from Douala Station in a northern suburb of Monrovia for destinations around the country.
getting_around.es: Los taxis compartidos de larga distancia salen de la estación Douala, en un barrio del norte de Monrovia, hacia destinos de todo el país.
getting_around.quote: Long distance shared taxis leave from "Douala Station" in a northern suburb of Monrovia for destinations around the country.

getting_around.en: There are no long distance buses for tourists.
getting_around.es: No hay autobuses de larga distancia para turistas.
getting_around.quote: There are no long distance buses for tourists.

getting_around.en: Most foreigners travelling by road outside Monrovia hire a car with a driver and travel in a convoy of at least 2 vehicles.
getting_around.es: La mayoría de extranjeros que viajan por carretera fuera de Monrovia alquila un coche con conductor y viaja en convoy de al menos 2 vehículos.
getting_around.quote: Most foreign nationals travelling by road outside Monrovia will hire a car with a driver, and travel in convoy of at least 2 vehicles in case of breakdowns or possible security incidents.

getting_around.en: Gas is sold in US gallons, not litres, and most distances and speed limits are posted in miles per hour.
getting_around.es: La gasolina se vende en galones estadounidenses, no en litros, y la mayoría de distancias y límites de velocidad están en millas.
getting_around.quote: Gas is sold in US gallons, not litres. Most distances and speed limits are posted in miles per hour.

money.en: The currency is the Liberian dollar, denoted by "$" or "L$" (LRD).
money.es: La moneda es el dólar liberiano, representado con «$» o «L$» (LRD).
money.quote: The currency of the country is the Liberian dollar, denoted by the symbol "$" or "L$" (ISO currency code: LRD).

money.en: Liberia remains a predominantly cash-based society, especially with street vendors.
money.es: Liberia sigue siendo una sociedad basada sobre todo en el efectivo, especialmente con los vendedores ambulantes.
money.quote: Liberia remains a predominantly cash-based society, especially with street vendors.

money.en: Cards are not generally accepted, except at a few major hotels and some larger supermarkets.
money.es: Las tarjetas no se aceptan en general, salvo en algunos grandes hoteles y supermercados grandes.
money.quote: Credit and debit cards are not generally accepted in Liberia, except for a few of the major hotels and some larger supermarkets.

money.en: ATMs often run out of money or only have certain denominations.
money.es: Los cajeros a menudo se quedan sin dinero o solo tienen ciertos billetes.
money.quote: ATMs often run out of money or only have certain denominations.

money.en: Bring sufficient funds in US dollars to cover all expenses.
money.es: Lleva fondos suficientes en dólares estadounidenses para cubrir todos los gastos.
money.quote: Bring sufficient funds, in US dollars, to cover all expenses.

money.en: All Ecobank ATMs in Liberia take Mastercard and Visa cards for cash withdrawal.
money.es: Todos los cajeros de Ecobank en Liberia aceptan tarjetas Mastercard y Visa para sacar efectivo.
money.quote: All Ecobank ATMs in Liberia take Mastercard/Visa card for cash withdrawal.

etiquette.en: It is customary to always greet people wherever you go.
etiquette.es: Es costumbre saludar siempre a la gente allá donde vayas.
etiquette.quote: It is customary to always greet people wherever you go.

etiquette.en: Saying "no" directly to requests is considered rude, so Liberians may pester you until you give in.
etiquette.es: Decir «no» directamente a una petición se considera de mala educación, por lo que algunos liberianos pueden insistir hasta que cedas.
etiquette.quote: Saying "no" directly to requests is considered rude, which is why Liberians may often pester you until you give in.

etiquette.en: Avoid discussing the Liberian Civil Wars, as they can easily bring up bad memories.
etiquette.es: Evita hablar de las guerras civiles liberianas, pues pueden despertar fácilmente malos recuerdos.
etiquette.quote: Avoid discussing the Liberian Civil Wars; they can very easily bring up bad memories for people.

etiquette.en: It is advisable to bring some business cards, as they are given out at every function.
etiquette.es: Conviene llevar algunas tarjetas de visita, pues se reparten en todos los actos.
etiquette.quote: It is advisable to bring some business cards. They are given out at every function.

connectivity.en: You need a GSM SIM card (US$1) and prepaid recharge "Scratch Cards", most commonly US$1 and US$5.
connectivity.es: Necesitas una tarjeta SIM GSM (1 US$) y tarjetas de recarga prepago llamadas «Scratch Card», normalmente de 1 y 5 US$.
connectivity.quote: You will need to purchase a GSM SIM card (US$1) and prepaid recharge cards (most commonly in denominations of US$1 and US$5), called "Scratch Card" locally.

connectivity.en: Internet access is most commonly via GPRS/HSPA+ or restaurants, pubs, bars and hotels offering it free or for a small charge.
connectivity.es: El acceso a internet suele ser por GPRS/HSPA+ o en restaurantes, bares y hoteles que lo ofrecen gratis o por un pequeño cargo.
connectivity.quote: The most common access to the internet is by GPRS/HSPA+ or restaurants, pubs, bars and hotels that offer free internet services to customers or for a small charge.
